item.subtype: parallel verb forms in a list (gerund vs. base form)
item.sentence: Measuring reaction rates precisely, to control temperature fluctuations, and to record every observation carefully are essential skills for any laboratory chemist.

marked_parts.C: and to record every observation carefully
marked_parts.D: are essential skills for any laboratory chemist

item.answer_explanation: The compound subject lists parallel infinitive phrases ("to control," "to record"), so the first item must also be an infinitive ("To measure") rather than the gerund "Measuring."

issues.description: Subtype text reads "gerund vs. base form" but the actual contrast in the sentence is gerund vs. to-infinitive (B and C are infinitive phrases "to control"/"to record"), not bare base form. Wording only; does not affect the correctness of the item.
